name: Ukraine
description: Ukraine from Trypillia and the Scythians to Kievan Rus, the Cossacks, Russian and Soviet rule, the Holodomor, Chernobyl, independence and the war.

checkpoints.name: The steppe and Rus
checkpoints.note: Trypillian farmers built great towns, and Scythians rode the steppe. Kyiv became the capital of Rus in the 800s.

checkpoints.name: Cossacks and empires
checkpoints.note: The Mongols sacked Kyiv in 1240. Poland-Lithuania ruled, the Cossacks rose in 1648, and Russia took most of the land.

checkpoints.name: Soviet Ukraine
checkpoints.note: A Ukrainian state was crushed after 1917. The Holodomor, the Nazi occupation and the Chernobyl disaster struck.

checkpoints.name: Independent Ukraine
checkpoints.note: Ukraine became independent in 1991. The Orange Revolution and Euromaidan pushed it west, and Russia took Crimea in 2014 and invaded in full in 2022.
